name: Facet
text: Adopt a dark theme by default with a one-click toggle to light mode. This keeps the interface readable in low light and reduces eye strain, which matters for long screentime. The trade-off is that some users may prefer light mode for daylight readability, but the toggle makes it reversible. This aligns with Manus’ competitive analysis and Graphify’s dark interface, ensuring consistency with proven UX patterns.

name: Pane
text: Dark mode by default still ignores users who need light mode for daylight readability—especially those with visual impairments or migraines triggered by glare. A better alternative is a system that remembers the user’s last mode choice and defaults to it, with a visible toggle. Settle it by testing both approaches with users who report glare sensitivity and measuring task completion time in bright vs. low light.
